purpose: Controlled new-item row mapping from grabbing 2 Chicken Eggs.

confirmed_simple_row.name: Chicken's Egg
confirmed_simple_row.layout: 3-byte default RefID + signed int32 count + 1-byte extra-data flag

build_changes: Player inventory scanner now uses the packaged reference database when scoring known FormIDs, fixing under-counting on the newest save.
Added insert_simple_player_inventory_item() for simple missing base items with no extra data.
Item Database / AddItem now includes Add Missing To Save, which backs up the current save before inserting.
Direct insertion is limited to normal base FormIDs and simple stacks; existing rows still use count editing.
safety_notes: Back up is created before writing.
Unsupported XX/FE/FF IDs are rejected for direct insertion.
Enchanted, tempered, poisoned, equipped, owned, or custom-extra-data items are not supported by direct insertion yet.
The generated save parses back through the editor; user should test in-game on a copy before relying on it.
